what: The arc's stated predictions that the active layer draws — PG01 §2 ledger entries with observables on this page. Derived from the PG01 markdown (canonical); update both together. Hand-dated; the pipeline never writes here. Press rows (H1–H4, 2026-10-15): principals' contemporaneous statements as trackable hypotheses — Sailor's 10-10 direction, drafted from the Breaking Points cut of 10-12; Claude drafts until ruled.

rows.short: The shock realizes the object by re-routing it.
rows.stated: The next member traceframe (TF03, the Strait closure) scores the real object at z ≥ +0.8, with the realization read at the hemisphere barrel: Gulf supply to the US goes to zero and is replaced by Western-Hemisphere supply that is dollar-settled by construction; the dollar-settled share of US crude imports does not fall through the shock.
rows.falsifiedIf: TF03's record shows the replacement barrel settled outside the dollar, or the Gulf edge returns before the hemisphere edges consolidate.
rows.scoredBy: TF03 — ruled, unauthored. The flows do not score z; TF03 does.

observables.label: Gulf share of US crude imports
Hemisphere share of US crude imports

rows.short: Russian diesel lands in the US, and prices fall.
rows.stated: Russia will immediately supply over 300,000 tons of diesel to the American and global marketplace, another 500,000 tons during November, a million tons immediately thereafter, and 3 million tons within a short period; diesel prices will come down in record numbers.
rows.falsifiedIf: H1a: Russian-origin diesel cargo cleared by CBP at a US port — >= 300,000 t by 2026-11-03; H1b: Russian-origin diesel delivered (US + global) — 500,000 t by 2026-11-30; H1c: US retail diesel price (EIA weekly) — below 2026-10-10 level by 2026-11-30
rows.scoredBy: the record, term by term (the active layer fetches H1a/H1c; H2/H3 by the detection series)

observables.label: Russian-origin diesel into the US (EIA distillate imports by origin)

pressNotes.note: The Daily (10-14) reads the terms with a condition the register does not carry: "potentially millions more… depending on the state of Russian oil refineries" — the principal’s own falsifier, tying H1 to H2. Proposed terms amendment. The tape dates the announcement Friday 10-09 (Shell Bay → Truth Social); the register says 10-11.

rows.short: An energy ceasefire holds, both sides.
rows.stated: Effective immediately, there is an energy ceasefire in the war between Russia and Ukraine. Both parties have agreed, do not break it.
rows.falsifiedIf: H2a: strikes on energy infrastructure by either party after statement — 0 by open
rows.scoredBy: the record, term by term (the active layer fetches H1a/H1c; H2/H3 by the detection series)
rows.falsifiedBy: strikes by both sides within hours of the 10-11 'effective immediately' statement (BP 10-12 record; Sailor's ruling 2026-10-15)

rows.short: Sixty days of total ceasefire, then an election.
rows.stated: Tell Putin: give us 60 days of total ceasefire and we will organize elections.
rows.falsifiedIf: H3a: a total ceasefire begins — yes by 2026-12-31; H3b: election scheduled within 60 days of H3a — yes by H3a + 60d
rows.scoredBy: the record, term by term (the active layer fetches H1a/H1c; H2/H3 by the detection series)

rows.short: Total control of the Strait: the Gulf edge stays at zero or returns on US terms.
rows.stated: Between our total control of the Strait of Hormuz and this great procurement of Russian energy, diesel prices for Americans and the world will be coming down.
rows.falsifiedIf: H4a: Gulf → US crude edge (active layer §6) — stays 0 or returns under US terms by TF03 authoring
